dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday! SkyForge 415, both engines have flamed out after bird strike at eight thousand feet!

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: SkyForge 415, Tower roger Mayday, squawk 7700. Wind calm, all runways available, turn heading two seven zero immediately.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: We are attempting APU restart, airspeed two hundred knots, descending rapidly through five thousand, heading two seven zero.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: SkyForge 415, radar contact four miles east. Runway two eight Right is completely cleared, emergency vehicles dispatched.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Tower, restart failed on both spools. We cannot maintain altitude to reach the threshold, we are ditching in the Hudson River.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: SkyForge 415, copy ditching, Coast Guard and harbor police alerted. We have eyes on you, godspeed.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday! AeroStar 304, rapid cabin depressurization, initiating emergency dive to ten thousand feet!

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: AeroStar 304, Tower roger emergency descent, airspace underneath is cleared. Turn left heading one eight zero.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Speed brakes extended, diving through flight level two zero zero, passenger oxygen masks deployed, First Officer has controls.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: AeroStar 304, altimeter two niner niner two, wind zero niner zero at eight, runway one six Left ready for straight-in arrival.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Leveling at ten thousand feet, cabin pressure stabilized, oxygen systems nominal. Direct to airport, AeroStar 304.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: AeroStar 304, cleared straight-in approach runway one six Left, emergency services on standby at taxiway Charlie.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Tower, CargoExpress 88 heavy, declaring emergency, main deck cargo smoke detector illuminated, discharge bottles fired.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: CargoExpress 88 heavy, copy cargo smoke warning. Maintain present heading, descend to four thousand feet.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Smoke entering flight deck, donning oxygen masks and goggles. Request immediate vectors for nearest runway.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: CargoExpress 88 heavy, turn right heading zero four zero, runway zero four is eight miles out, crash fire trucks rolling.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Visual with the runway, gear down and locked, CargoExpress 88 heavy.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: CargoExpress 88 heavy, cleared to land runway zero four, fire crews will follow you down the roll out.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Tower, Pacific 712, windshear warning, maximum thrust set, executing missed approach!

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: Pacific 712, Tower rogers windshear go-around, climb and maintain four thousand feet, fly runway heading.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Airspeed fluctuating plus minus thirty knots on short final, positive rate, gear coming up.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: Pacific 712, low level windshear alert system triggered, microburst reported over approach corridor. Turn heading three six zero.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Turning three six zero, climbing through three thousand, aircraft under control. Requesting holding pattern to evaluate weather.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: Pacific 712, hold north of airport at five thousand, expect twenty minute delay for cell to pass.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Tower, Falcon 90, declaring emergency, total loss of primary hydraulic pressure, alternate manual gear extension in progress.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: Falcon 90, Tower copies hydraulic failure. Say number of souls on board and fuel endurance.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: One hundred sixty-two souls on board, three hours fuel. Request flyby at one thousand feet for visual gear check.

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: Falcon 90, cleared low approach runway two two at one thousand feet, tower binoculars ready.

dialogue.speaker: Pilot
dialogue.text: Falcon 90 over the numbers now, do you see three green?

dialogue.speaker: Tower
dialogue.text: Falcon 90, nose gear and main gear look down and fully locked. Cleared to circle to land runway two two, crash trucks in position.
